title: ‘I Can’t Stop Thinking About It’: Chloe Fineman on 'You Can See Everything'
text:

 On the red carpet at the 2026 TIME100 Next Gala in New York City on Oct. 29, actor and comedian Chloe Fineman praised You Can See Everything, the new hit documentary about Elizabeth Holmes , the disgraced founder of blood-testing company Theranos.
 “It was amazing,” Fineman said. “I can’t stop thinking about it.”
 Directed by Nathan Fielder and Lance Oppenheim, You Can See Everything follows Holmes and her partner Billy Evans—along with their two kids—during a 34-day-long period in 2023, just before Holmes began serving her federal prison sentence after being convicted of fraud in 2022. Since its U.S. theatrical release earlier this month, the film has generated praise from critics, sparked heated discourse online, and grossed more than $45 million.
 Read More: Elizabeth Holmes Is Not the Problem With You Can See Everything 
 Fineman, who wrote the 2026 TIME100 Next profile on fashion designer Daniella Kallmeyer , echoed that praise for the documentary on Oct. 29. 
 Back in 2019, Fineman shared a video of herself impersonating Holmes on Instagram, donning Holmes’ then-signature black turtleneck and heavy black eyeliner—a clip she reshared on TikTok in September, ahead of the film’s release.
 On the red carpet, Fineman joked that Holmes is a “kindred spirit” because neither of them blink frequently. Fineman went on to say she was “excited” to see what Halloween costumes people come up with this year, inspired by the documentary. 
 She also shared how one moment in You Can See Everything , in particular, stuck with her: “The egg whisking—a really haunting moment, I think, for many women and men,” Fineman said. “There [were] a lot of harrowing moments.”
 The TIME100 Next Gala was presented by Rolex, Toyota, American Airlines, Danantara, Project Management Institute, and Target.
